name: Ring of Three Wishes

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: 3 charges, each a casting of Wish; it becomes nonmagical when the last is spent.
text: While wearing this ring, you can expend 1 of its 3 charges to cast Wish from it. The ring becomes nonmagical when you use the last charge.
